Home.quote: The body adapts to what you ask of it.

intro.title: A global approach to movement, health and function.
intro.body: Three specialities, one philosophy: individualised care, based on a global understanding of the body, to restore and preserve your functional capacity, your health and your quality of life. My approach rests on a single principle: understanding how the body works in order to offer personalised care, grounded in current scientific evidence and tailored to each patient’s goals.

PhysioPage.title: Scientific rigour, human attention.
PhysioPage.lead: I’m a physiotherapist, trained in Belgium, with a passion for movement, health and performance. My path has taken me through varied settings: from professional sport to general private practice, and specialised fields such as senology and geriatrics.
PhysioPage.parcoursP1: These experiences let me discover different approaches to physiotherapy and develop a rich, nuanced view of care. I learned there is no single way to treat - but a multitude of paths, to adapt to each patient.
PhysioPage.parcoursP2: My practice draws on scientifically validated techniques while giving listening an essential place. Every person is unique, with their own story, goals and needs. My role is to understand that uniqueness and offer tailored support.
PhysioPage.parcoursP3: Driven by a sincere desire to help, I commit to guiding my patients towards their best version - in recovery, prevention or performance.
PhysioPage.trailP1: Practising trail running at a high level reinforces the values that guide my practice every day: listening, rigour, perseverance and care centred on each patient. My goal is to guide everyone, athlete or not, towards lasting recovery - regaining confidence in their body, returning to their activities in the best conditions and reaching their goals safely.
PhysioPage.formationsIntro: My path has been guided by a constant drive to gain recognised skills from leading institutions, so I can offer care grounded in best practice.

formationsList.body: Physiotherapy degree obtained in Brussels, then Swiss equivalence validated by the Swiss Red Cross - the authorisation to practise in Switzerland.
Taught by the official trainers of the Leduc School, an internationally recognised reference method.

formationsList.org: Dry Needling · David G. Simons Academy
formationsList.body: With an internationally renowned institution specialised in the treatment of myofascial pain.
A long-form training in biomechanics, manual therapy and athlete care, from amateur to elite level.
Regular training days on LPG technologies: endermologie, scar treatment and drainage.

PhysioPage.formationsOutro: Today I keep expanding my skills across my three areas of expertise - general physio, sports physio and dermato-functional physio - through seminars and exchanges with other health professionals.

Prestations.title: Three areas of expertise, one tailored care.
Prestations.lead: Medical (with or without a prescription), sport and aesthetic - individualised and recognised by Swiss basic insurance.

medical.title: General and Medical Physiotherapy.
medical.lead: Every patient is unique: a thorough assessment, then personalised, effective and lasting care.
medical.card: Recognised by all Swiss basic insurance. Any musculoskeletal condition or injury.
medical.metaDescription: Medical and general physiotherapy in Lausanne: orthopaedics, traumatology, rehabilitation, dry needling. With or without a prescription, recognised by basic insurance.
medical.machinesIntro: The practice is equipped with the Huber 360® Evolution by LPG Medical, used alongside manual techniques for functional rehabilitation.

machines.name: Huber 360® Evolution
machines.body: A motorised platform that engages the entire musculoskeletal system: balance, deep strengthening, mobility and coordination. Its built-in functional assessment tracks progress session after session.

bodyParas: Every patient is unique. My care always starts with a thorough assessment - your symptoms, your history, your lifestyle and your goals - to identify the causes of the problem, not just treat the pain.

I treat musculoskeletal disorders, traumatology, rheumatological conditions and chronic pain, whether recent or long-standing. Treatment combines the techniques suited to your clinical assessment to relieve pain, restore mobility and prevent recurrence - making you an actor in your own rehabilitation.
medical.indicationsIntro: What I treat, day to day.
indications: Back pain: low back, neck and mid-back pain
Sprains, dislocations and sports or everyday injuries
Rehabilitation after fracture or orthopaedic surgery
Painful shoulder: subacromial impingement, frozen shoulder, instability
Knee pain: patellofemoral syndrome, ligament or meniscus injuries
Tennis elbow, golfer’s elbow, other elbow pain
Headaches and migraines of musculoskeletal origin
Limited mobility and loss of strength
Preventing recurrence and returning to activity
medical.coverageText: Medical and general physiotherapy sessions are covered by Swiss health insurance (LAMal) and accident insurance (LAA) with a valid medical prescription. You benefit from personalised treatment, based on current scientific recommendations, at no extra cost beyond the terms of your insurance.

dry.title: Targeted treatment of myofascial pain.
dry.text: Trained with the David G. Simons Academy, an internationally renowned institution, I use dry needling to treat myofascial pain and muscle trigger points.

sport.title: Physiotherapy & Sport.
sport.lead: Every athlete is unique and deserves tailored attention, adapted to their level. From amateur athletes to elite competitors: assessment, planning, coaching, recovery and treatment of sport-related pain, by a qualified sports physiotherapist who is himself a high-level trail runner.
sport.card: Personalised sports follow-up, assessment and goal planning. For every level, from getting back in shape to competition.
sport.metaDescription: Sports physiotherapy in Lausanne: assessment, goal planning, prevention and recovery. Athlete follow-up from amateur to elite level.

max.title: Alongside Maximilien Drion.
max.text: I also support <link>Maximilien Drion</link>, an international ski-mountaineering athlete and winner of several World Cup races.
max.text2: Every winter I follow him on part of the international circuit, travelling with him to various World Cup stages to ensure his follow-up, his recovery and the management of performance-related demands.

athlete.title: Trail running, lived from the inside.
athlete.p1: Alongside my work as a physiotherapist, I am myself a high-level trail runner. This dual experience gives me a precise understanding of the demands of performance sport: training load, preparation periods, the constraints of the competition calendar, recovery and athletes’ expectations.
athlete.p2: Elite sport is an integral part of my daily life and feeds my clinical practice. This immersion helps me understand the needs of every athlete - and those of amateur athletes too. Because I know the realities of the field, I can offer pragmatic care, grounded in current scientific evidence and tailored to each person’s goals. My ambition is to help you practise your sport sustainably, with confidence, and regain the best level of performance you are capable of.

bodyParas: I support athletes of all levels, from recreational practitioners to elite competitors, in prevention, injury treatment and performance optimisation. Whether your goal is to return to physical activity, prepare for a race, reach a personal goal or perform in competition, every treatment plan is individualised according to your discipline, your level and your constraints.

I regularly work with runners, trail runners, cyclists, skiers and footballers. Beyond treating pain, my approach aims to identify the factors behind the injury, optimise training-load management and help you return to your best level of practice in lasting conditions.

intl.title: At the highest level of international sport.
paras: My work also takes me to the highest level of international sport. I served as a physiotherapist for a Belgian First Division football club, where I gained solid experience in the day-to-day care of professional athletes.
In skiing, I work at the Xtreme de Verbier final, the iconic stage of the <fwt>Freeride World Tour</fwt>, where I look after the athletes throughout this major event.

In trail running, I join the <scott>Scott Running International</scott> medical staff at leading competitions such as <utmb>UTMB®</utmb>, following athletes before and after their races. I also support professional cyclists in managing pain linked to heavy training loads and the demands of their discipline.

items.d: Functional diagnosis, treatment, rehabilitation and support for the return to sport, whatever your discipline or level of practice.
Recovery techniques adapted to periods of intensive training, competition or return to sport, to optimise performance and limit the risk of injury.
Physiotherapy follow-up in Lausanne or on the road (competitions, training camps, sporting events), with care adapted to the demands of the field.

Advice on organising your preparation, training-load management, injury prevention and personalised support to reach your goals - a first race, a marathon, an ultra-trail, a sportive or an elite competition.

sport.coverageText: Sports physiotherapy sessions can be covered by LAMal basic insurance, on presentation of a physiotherapy prescription issued by your doctor.

esthetic.title: Dermato-functional physiotherapy.
esthetic.lead: Plastic surgery • Lipoedema • Lymphoedema • Lymphatic drainage • Scars • LPG® • Post-operative rehabilitation
bodyParas: Dermato-functional physiotherapy is a speciality dedicated to the care of skin, subcutaneous and lymphatic tissue conditions. It combines clinical expertise, manual therapy and advanced technologies to optimise patients’ functional and aesthetic recovery.

My care is designed for patients undergoing plastic, reconstructive or aesthetic surgery, as well as for people with lipoedema, lymphoedema or any other condition requiring specific care of the lymphatic system and tissues.
Each treatment protocol is designed individually to respect the physiology of healing, promote tissue remodelling and enable optimal recovery, both functionally and aesthetically.

surgery.title: Expertise before, during and after surgery.
surgery.prehabText: The quality of recovery is prepared before the operation itself. A pre-operative consultation assesses the tissues, optimises lymphatic circulation, prepares the patient for the stages of recovery and puts in place the first measures for quality healing.
surgery.rehabIntro: I support patients after many plastic and reconstructive surgery procedures, including:
surgery.rehabOutro: The goal is a fast, safe recovery - limiting pain, oedema and tissue tension while preserving the quality of the surgical result.

drainage.title: A fundamental therapeutic act.
drainage.intro: Manual lymphatic drainage is a specific therapeutic technique designed to stimulate lymphatic circulation, reduce oedema and support the tissues’ natural repair mechanisms. It is a cornerstone of dermato-functional physiotherapy.
drainage.listIntro: Depending on your situation, it may be indicated for:
items: After plastic, reconstructive or aesthetic surgery
After oncology treatment (notably breast surgery or lymph-node dissection)
Heavy-legs sensation linked to lymphatic insufficiency
drainage.outro: The lymphatic drainage practised at the clinic is a therapeutic act. It is based on a precise clinical assessment and forms part of comprehensive care tailored to each patient.

scars.title: Treating scars and fibrosis.
scars.intro: The quality of a scar does not depend on the surgery alone, but also on how it is supported through the phases of healing. Using specific manual therapy techniques, I work on:
scars.outro: The goal is to restore tissue suppleness, improve mobility and durably optimise the aesthetic result.

complications.title: Specialised care for difficult recoveries.
complications.intro: Some post-operative situations require specialised care to speed up recovery and prevent functional sequelae. I treat in particular:
complications.outro: Every treatment respects the biological stage of healing and the surgeon’s recommendations.

lipo.title: Specialised, lasting support.
lipo.intro: I offer specialised care for patients with lipoedema or lymphoedema, whether conservative or as part of a surgical pathway. Treatment may combine:
items: Support for the return to physical activity
lipo.outro: The goal is to reduce pain, improve mobility, control the oedema and durably preserve quality of life.

endermo.title: Technology in the service of care.
paras: LPG® medical endermologie effectively complements care when indicated.
This technology stimulates microcirculation, promotes drainage, softens tissues, limits fibrotic phenomena and supports tissue remodelling after surgery or in certain lymphatic conditions.
It forms part of a comprehensive therapeutic strategy, adapted to the stage of recovery and each patient’s needs.

reeduc.title: Functional rehabilitation and return to sport.
paras: Regaining optimal function is an essential stage of recovery.

I design an individualised programme to progressively restore mobility, strength and physical capacity while respecting the biological timelines of healing. The goal is a return to sport and daily activities in the safest conditions.

expertise.title: Care built on expertise.
paras: Every patient receives a full clinical assessment to build a personalised care protocol. My approach draws on current knowledge in physiotherapy, plastic surgery and lymphology, while taking into account your surgeon’s recommendations and your goals.

Because the quality of the result does not depend on the surgical act alone, but also on the quality of the rehabilitation that accompanies it, I put my expertise at the service of an optimal, lasting recovery that respects tissue physiology.

esthetic.metaDescription: Dermato-functional physiotherapy in Lausanne: rehabilitation after plastic surgery, lipoedema, lymphoedema, manual lymphatic drainage, scars, LPG® endermologie.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how Thomas Derême, self-employed physiotherapist, processes the personal data of users of the website www.thomasdereme.ch, in accordance with the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nFADP) and, where applicable, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) for visitors located in the European Union.

blocks.text: For any question about this policy or to exercise your rights, you can contact Thomas Derême directly using the details above.
When you contact us by e-mail, phone or WhatsApp, or when you book an appointment, you share certain personal data with us, in particular:

items: The content of your message or request

blocks.text: This data is used solely to respond to your request, organise your appointment or handle the administrative follow-up of your file.

No health data is collected directly through the website. Medical information is gathered exclusively as part of therapeutic care at the practice, and is subject to professional secrecy as well as the rules applicable to medical records (retention, confidentiality, restricted access).

Online appointments are booked through the third-party platform OneDoc. When you use this service, your data (name, contact details, chosen time slot) is processed directly by OneDoc, in accordance with its own privacy policy. We invite you to read it on the OneDoc website before using this service.
Subject to your consent, the website uses:

items: Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd.), with Consent Mode v2 and IP address anonymisation, to produce anonymised traffic statistics (pages viewed, visit duration, traffic sources). This data does not allow you to be identified personally.
Google Maps, to display the location of the practice. The map is only loaded, and only transmits data to Google, after you accept cookies via the banner provided for this purpose.

blocks.text: You can accept, decline or withdraw your consent to these cookies at any time via the banner displayed on the website.
Your data is processed for the following purposes:

items: Responding to your contact or information requests
Managing the booking and follow-up of your appointments
Handling the administrative and therapeutic follow-up of the practice's patients
Measuring the website's audience and improving its content (with your consent)
Displaying the location of the practice (with your consent)
Complying with our legal obligations, in particular regarding medical record keeping

blocks.text: Under the nFADP and, where applicable, the GDPR, the processing described above is based on:

items: Your consent, for audience-measurement cookies and the Google Maps map
The performance of a contractual or pre-contractual relationship, for appointment management and therapeutic care
Our legal obligations, in particular regarding the retention of medical records
Our legitimate interest, in responding to your contact requests

blocks.text: Your data may be shared with the following service providers, strictly to the extent necessary for the purposes described:

items: Google Ireland Ltd. (Google Analytics, Google Maps)

blocks.text: Your data is never sold, rented or shared with third parties for commercial purposes.

Some providers (in particular Google) may process data outside Switzerland, including in the United States. These transfers are governed by appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses or equivalent mechanisms recognised by the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner).

items: Data sent by e-mail, phone or WhatsApp is kept for as long as necessary to handle your request.
Patient records are kept in accordance with the legal obligations applicable to healthcare professionals in Switzerland (in principle 10 years after the end of treatment, unless otherwise provided).
Audience-measurement data (Google Analytics) is kept according to the settings defined in our Google Analytics account, generally 14 months.

blocks.text: Appropriate technical and organisational measures are in place to protect your data against unauthorised access, loss, disclosure or alteration.
In accordance with the nFADP (and the GDPR where applicable), you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items: Right of access: obtain confirmation that data concerning you is being processed, as well as a copy of that data
Right to rectification: have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected
Right to erasure: request the deletion of your data, within the limits provided by law (in particular the obligations to retain medical records)
Right to object: object to certain processing, in particular processing based on your consent
Right to withdraw your consent at any time, for processing that depends on it (cookies, Google Maps), without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal

blocks.text: To exercise these rights, contact Thomas Derême using the details given in section 1.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC): www.edoeb.admin.ch.

The website only uses cookies for audience measurement (Google Analytics) and to display the Google Maps map. No advertising cookies are used. You can manage your preferences via the cookie banner shown on your first visit, and change them at any time.

This privacy policy may be updated at any time, in particular to keep up with changes in legislation or in the services used on the website. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this document.
